question: Which of the following is known as golden fiber?
solution:
The correct answer is __Jute.__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Jute is known as the "Golden fibre" because of its golden color and its importance as a cash crop for many countries.
 
• Jute is primarily grown in India, Bangladesh, and China, and is used for making products such as bags, carpets, and ropes.
 
• Sugarcane is an important crop in many tropical countries, particularly in South America and Asia.
 
• It is used for making sugar, molasses, and ethanol.
 
• Wheat is a major crop in many countries, particularly in Europe and North America.
 
• It is used for making flour, which is used to make bread, pasta, and other food products. 
 
• Rice is a staple food in many countries, particularly in Asia.
 
• It is used for making rice dishes, such as sushi and risotto. ​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Jute**

 
 
• It is a long, soft, shiny vegetable fiber that is spun into coarse, strong threads.
 
• It is one of the cheapest natural fibres and is second only to cotton in terms of usage.
 
 
 
• **Mustard**
 
 
• It is Often referred to as "**Yellow Gold**" due to its valuable oilseed and condiment properties.
 
• The **Scientific Name is ** *Brassica* species (primarily *Brassica juncea* in India).
 
• A widely grown **Rabi crop in India, particularly in Rajasthan, Haryana, Uttar Pradesh, and Punjab.**
 
 
 
• **Sandalwood**
 
 
• It is known as "**Green Gold**" because of its high economic and cultural value in the perfumery and religious industries.
 
• The **Scientific Name is ***Santalum album* (Indian sandalwood).
 
• Sandalwood has c**ooling, antiseptic, and calming properties** and is used in Ayurvedic treatments.
 
• Grown mainly in **Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, and Kerala**, it is a protected resource in India.
 
 
 
• **Wheat**
 
 
• It is called "**Golden Grain" **due to its golden appearance and significance as a staple food crop globally.
 
• The **Scientific Name is ***Triticum aestivum*
 
• **India is one of the largest producers of wheat i**n the world, primarily grown in Uttar Pradesh, Punjab, and Madhya Pradesh.
